text: Butter or other fat was packed in a wooden vessel and sunk into peat, where the cold, acidic, oxygen-poor bog kept it for years. No ferment is involved, so there is no culture table.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: pack
steps.note: The butter or other fat is put into a wooden bucket, keg, barrel, dish or churn, sealed, and sometimes wrapped in deerskin bladder or plant fibre.

steps.name: bury
steps.note: The vessel is sunk into a peat bog.
